record.question: From the following particulars, calculate the qualifying service of a Government servant - Born on 1.6.1952; Appointed as temporary clerk 1.12.1977; Confirmed as a clerk 1.7.1981; He enjoyed the following leave: (a) EL for 90 days from 1.4.1983 and extension of EL for 30 days. Overstayed the leave by 15 days. (b) HPL for 140 days from 1.8.1987. (c) HPL for 180 days from 9.4.1990 and extension of HPL for 20 days thereafter. (d) Leave without pay which will not count as qualifying for 56 days from 6.10.1991 to 30.11.1991. (e) HPL for 20 days from 1.12.1991 to 20.12.1991. (f) Leave without pay not counting for pension for 364 days from 21.12.1991. (g) EL for 120 days combined with Commuted Leave for 90 days from 1.1.2001. (h) EL for 61 days from 1.3.2003. He was placed under suspension from 11.7.1995 and was reinstated on 1.7.1996. The period of suspension was not to be treated as qualifying service for pension. The spells of leave without pay taken by the Government servant will not count as qualifying service for pension. He retired from service on superannuation pension from 31.5.2012 (A/N).
